rationale: Price has round-tripped from a failed push above yesterday's high ($49.31 → $49.85) back down to a support confluence of yesterday's high, session VWAP ($49.21), and the rising 9-EMA ($49.20), with five consecutive 1-minute lower closes but no actual break of support — the inflection is unresolved. Shorting here means selling into VWAP support in a name showing 6.2x relative volume and outperformance vs. a weak tape (+0.3% vs SPY -0.69%), while going long means buying against sequential lower highs in a risk-off tape (VIXY +2.37%) with no stabilization bar printed. With a 28 bps spread imposing heavy round-trip friction at the start of the midday chop window and no measurable edge either way, the highest-expectancy action is to wait for resolution — a VWAP break favors a short toward $48.50, a reclaim of $49.60+ favors a long toward $49.85.
